title.rendered: First Day of School Grades 1-5 August 30th

content.rendered:
The first day of school for students in grades 1-5 is Wednesday, August 30th.

School hours are from 7:55 am-2:15 pm.

Arrival begins at 7:45-7:55 am at the front and activity side doors.

Dismissal is at 2:15 pm at the teacher’s exterior doors.
